estonia.title: NATO confirmă că o rachetă rusească, „de un tip încă necunoscut”, s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul Poloniei
estonia.description: NATO a transmis joi că a activat, împreună cu Polonia, sistemele de apărare aeriană și terestră după ce, potrivit Alianței, o rachetă rusească, al cărei tip nu a fost încă stabilit, a pătruns în spațiul aerian polonez și s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul țării, a declarat un purtător de cuvânt al comandamentului militar al NATO, potrivit …

estonia.title: Cea mai mare afacere din domeniul imobiliar făcută vreodată
estonia.description: Peter Minuit, guvernatorul colonial al orașului New Amsterdam, coboară de pe o navă olandeză, îi cheamă pe șefii indieni și începe negocierile. Le oferă mărgele, ace, pânză, cuțite și nasturi pentru a cumpăra întreaga insulă Manhattan. Adunate, toate obiectele valorau 24 de dolari, în banii de azi, scrie și The Atlantic. Va trebui să se …

estonia.title: Legea integrității, măcelărită în Parlament: PSD și AUR au votat ca demnitarii să fie scutiți de la declararea banilor cash / Amendamentul ”Fritz” vizează o singură persoană – președintele USR
estonia.description: Demnitarii vor fi scutiți de la declararea banilor cash pe care îi dețin, potrivit unui amendament la legea integrității depus joi în Comisia Juridică din Senat de senatoarea ”suveranistă” Cosmina Cerva și votat de PSD și AUR. Un alt amendament, depus de PSD și votat de AUR și de doi senatori PNL, e îndreptat împotriva […] © G4Media.ro .

estonia.title: Estonian conscripts allowed to grow beards, but stubble still off‑limits
estonia.description: Conscripts in the Estonian Defence Forces are allowed to grow beards, as long as they keep them neatly groomed, the Chancellor of Justice and Defence Forces officials clarified after questions about uniform-wearing rules.

estonia.title: 'Bronze Soldier' Night proved Estonia is a sovereign nation, says former PM
estonia.description: Next April will mark the 20th anniversary of the "Bronze Soldier" night riots in Estonia, and Andrus Ansip, prime minister at the time of the events, spoke to Vikerraadio about those nights in spring 2007.

estonia.title: Major police operation in Tallinn targets illegal migrants
estonia.description: A large police operation took place Thursday in Tallinn's Nõmme district to apprehend suspected migrants. According to local residents, police also used drones during the operation.

estonia.title: Tram to Tallinn Airport reopens in August
estonia.description: Tallinn's airport tramline was officially reopened on Thursday by representatives from the City of Tallinn, the Ministry of Climate and Rail Baltic, ahead of its relaunch on August 1.

estonia.title: Report says Estonia's working life could stretch to 45 years as lifespans rise
estonia.description: Eurostat projects that Estonians could live to 85 within the next 50 years, pushing average working life toward 45 years — a shift that would force people to relearn skills or even change careers multiple times, according to a new report from the Foresight Center.

estonia.title: Turkish Airlines: Entry into Russian airspace was a one‑off weather-related decision
estonia.description: Turkish Airlines, whose July 12 flight from Tallinn to Istanbul briefly entered Kaliningrad airspace, says the deviation was a one‑time safety‑driven exception caused by adverse weather conditions.

estonia.title: Powerful El Niño's ripple effects could eventually reach Estonia
estonia.description: A potentially record-setting El Niño is strengthening in the Pacific, as researchers warn its impacts, including global temperature spikes, could reach far beyond the tropics.

estonia.title: Police find €3,000 in cash in pockets of suspected money mule
estonia.description: Officers from the Northern Prefecture detained a 37‑year‑old Latvian resident in Tallinn on Monday, discovering €3,000 in cash in his pockets. Police believe he acted as a money mule in a series of fraud cases.

estonia.title: Full restoration not planned for Tartu Cathedral
estonia.description: It is not realistic to fully restore Tartu Cathedral with the University of Tartu's budget. Given current financial constraints, a feasible solution would be to stop the walls from deteriorating.

estonia.title: State cuts leave disability and patient groups facing shrinking funds
estonia.description: The Estonian Chamber of Disabled People will have to operate next year with 10 percent less state support, even as the government places increasing demands on patient‑advocacy nonprofits — demands that require more, not less, financial backing.

estonia.title: Tallinn, ministry divided on school International Baccalaureate admissions
estonia.description: Tallinn and Estonia's Education Ministry are at odds over expanding International Baccalaureate (IB) enrollment for returning families at Tallinn English College.

estonia.title: Minor spectator incidents mostly involving foreigners fail to mar Rally Estonia
estonia.description: The recent WRC Rally Estonia mostly went ahead without hitches, though there were a couple of incidents where spectators got so close to the trackside that the race had to be halted, Delfi reported.

estonia.title: Estonia's plan to tighten nicotine rules sparks black‑market concerns
estonia.description: Planned restrictions on nicotine products have triggered disagreements. The Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Social Affairs argue the measures would reduce youth consumption, while others warn they could fuel the growth of an illicit market.

estonia.title: Food plant turns to imports as weak cucumber harvest slows production
estonia.description: Newly Estonian‑owned factory in Põltsamaa Parish has begun its cucumber‑preserving season, but a weak local harvest means some of the produce will be imported from Germany and Finland.

estonia.title: Tallinn Zoo's chimps and elephants 'open' exhibition of their drawings and paintings
estonia.description: Some of Tallinn Zoo's animals have been getting creative with the paint and canvas, with the best offerings on display and even for sale.

estonia.title: GDP flash estimate: Economy grew by 2.1% in Q2 2026
estonia.description: Estonia's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by 2.1 percent year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026 (Q2 2026), Statistics Estonia reported.

estonia.title: 63 migrants from Belarus caught in Estonia last week and more expected, PPA says
estonia.description: Over the past week, 63 migrants with no legal right to be in Estonia have been caught by the police – almost double the number apprehended last year. The authorities say the situation is connected to the migration pressure on the Latvian-Belarus border and will likely continue until the weather worsens.

estonia.title: Gallery: New Tallinn viaduct mural taking shape
estonia.description: A street art project under the Pärnu Highway viaduct in Tallinn is taking shape, which aims to make the areas beneath the viaducts more visually attractive.

estonia.title: Anton Aleksejev: A conflict between two strategies in Ukraine
estonia.description: Mykhailo Fedorov's and Oleksandr Syrskyi's clash was a clash between two strategies. The first called for the systematic destruction of the enemy's infrastructure; the second was based on the simple fact that the front line must be held, and without soldiers no weapon — drone or missile — can fire, notes journalist Anton Aleksejev.

estonia.title: 1790 naval battle of Tallinn monument to be relocated to Aegna Island
estonia.description: The City of Tallinn has begun relocating two monuments located in the city center in connection with the completion of the extension of Tallinn Secondary School of Science (Tallinna Reaalkool).

estonia.title: EU official enters presidential race, with a focus on the economy
estonia.description: Long-serving European Commission official Maive Rute, has thrown her hat in the ring for a presidential bid and will run if she is asked to be a candidate.

estonia.title: Gallery: Rare medieval rings, coins and other artifacts uncovered at Siuru dig site
estonia.description: The largest archaeological excavation in Estonian history is underway on the grounds of Tartu's future Siuru cultural center. Among other finds, the work has uncovered a body of water whose size and purpose remain unclear.

estonia.title: Study: Obesity and weight issues cost Estonia over €120 million a year
estonia.description: While carrying a few surplus kilos can often be seen as a personal health issue, obesity costs Estonia over €120 million each year, according to a recent study.

estonia.title: New Narva mayor: There really are many problems that need immediate action
estonia.description: Newly elected Narva Mayor Jaan Toots said the 21‑kilometer heating pipeline being built between the city and the Auvere power plant will cut heating prices for Narva residents by nearly half. He said the biggest problem is unemployment.

estonia.title: Estonia's women's épée team climb to number 4 in the world
estonia.description: The Estonian women's épée team have risen three spots to fourth place in the international fencing rankings after their strong performance at the world championships which saw them take team silver.

estonia.title: Advertising agencies: AI overuse erodes a company's credibility
estonia.description: AI is getting to be a powerful tool in advertising, but excessive or inappropriate use could harm companies, marketers and advertisers have warned.

estonia.title: New nature-focused spa hotel opens on Lake Peipus in Ida-Viru County
estonia.description: A new spa has opened on the shores of Lake Peipus in eastern Estonia for the first time in more than 40 years, offering guests a break from the daily grind and the possibility to relax in nature.

estonia.title: Minister: Estonia sends extra border guards to Latvia as Belarus drives migrant surge
estonia.description: Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border. The decision came after several dozen illegal migrants who entered the country through Belarus and Latvia were detained in Estonia in recent days.

estonia.title: State considers replacing bankruptcy trustees with civil servants
estonia.description: Justice Minister Liisa Pakosta is proposing to replace bankruptcy trustees with civil servants or to cover trustee fees from the state budget in certain proceedings. The state's Insolvency Service said the idea is worthwhile, and one way to fund it could be an insolvency tax.

estonia.title: Estonian firefighters to help put out wildfires in Italy
estonia.description: Estonia's Rescue Services Agency will send a team of 20 firefighters to Italy to support local efforts to put out wildfires as southern Europe battles blazes and extreme heat.

estonia.title: 'Tartu Buzz' 2-week festival starts Saturday
estonia.description: This Saturday, August 1, sees the start of the "Tartu Sumin" fortnight-long Old Town summer festival in Estonia's second city.

estonia.title: Parties not hurrying to back diplomat's presidential bid
estonia.description: Politicians across party lines have reacted to diplomat Hannes Hanso's statement that he would run for president if asked, though none have pledged their support for him yet.

estonia.title: Estonian women's épée team narrowly miss world title, take silver
estonia.description: Estonia's women's épée foursome took silver at the World Championships in Hong Kong after going down to Olympic champions Italy by just one point, in the final.

estonia.title: Remo Kirss: The state must invest in all connections
estonia.description: In infrastructure debates, the focus tends to return again and again to how much a particular road or rail section costs. For some reason, the question of how much more expensive it becomes not to invest in them is not treated with sufficient seriousness, writes Remo Kirss.

estonia.title: Estonia's first remotely operated taxi crash raises accountability questions
estonia.description: The first traffic collision involving a remotely operated taxi in Tallinn has raised questions about who is responsible when no one is directly behind the wheel.

estonia.title: Saaremaa Opera Days attendance jumps 55% on year
estonia.description: Saaremaa Opera Days recorded a 55 percent increase in attendance this year, jumping from just over 9,000 visitors to almost 14,100.

estonia.title: Triin Talk: How to save Tallinn's Old Town from the rats
estonia.description: Tallinn's Old Town can be revived as a city center, but only by prioritizing local residents, services and businesses over unchecked tourism, writes PhD student Triin Talk.

estonia.title: Entrepreneurs investing millions in Estonia's largest data center
estonia.description: Several well-known Estonian entrepreneurs have invested tens of millions of euros in Estonia's largest data center, which will now focus on serving artificial intelligence and attracting international customers.

estonia.title: Photos: Demolition begins at Tallinn's Eesti Näitused expo center
estonia.description: Demolition has begun at Tallinn's former Eesti Näitused expo center, where a new residential development is planned along Pirita tee.

estonia.title: Prosecutor's Office puts money from conditionally terminated cases into a lottery pool
estonia.description: Financial obligations imposed in Estonian criminal cases ended through conditional termination used to have to be paid into the state treasury, but now that money may, through a lottery, end up with NGOs. Last week, two local sports clubs became €6000 richer.

estonia.title: Estonian schools struggle to fill math and primary‑class teaching jobs
estonia.description: Schools are looking most actively — through public job postings — for mathematics teachers and primary‑class teachers, but English teachers are also in very high demand. The largest number of vacancies is in Tallinn and Harju County, but teachers are frequently missing in Lääne‑Virumaa and Tartu County as well.

estonia.title: Infrastructure in Estonia surges while apartment construction falters
estonia.description: Apartment building in Estonia is currently sluggish, while infrastructure is booming, says Tarmo Pohlak, board member of the construction company Nordecon.

estonia.title: Ida-Viru County seeks tourism rebrand beyond Soviet-era 'ghost town' image
estonia.description: A move away from "nostalgia" for the Soviet era means Ida-Viru County is seeking a rebrand, one local tour guide said.

estonia.title: New ambassador to the US: I'm ready to run in presidential elections
estonia.description: Incoming Estonian ambassador to the United States Hannes Hanso has said he would be willing to be a candidate at September's Estonian presidential elections, if asked.

estonia.title: Hiiumaa and Saaremaa residents can soon travel with discounted tickets
estonia.description: The Ministry of Regional Affairs has revoked time-limited changes for discounted ferry tickets for Saaremaa and Hiiumaa following strong criticism.

estonia.title: One killed in Põltsamaa road traffic collision involving truck
estonia.description: A 35-year-old man was killed in a road traffic accident in Jõgeva County on Monday. The collision involved a truck and passenger vehicle.

estonia.title: Estonia launches €5 million Eesti.ai training procurement
estonia.description: The Government Office has launched a €5 million procurement for Eesti.ai training programs aimed at boosting AI skills among 100,000 working-age Estonian residents by 2027.

estonia.title: Setomaa farm museum seeking Seto names for 3 lambs
estonia.description: Three lambs born at Värska Farm Museum in July are still nameless as Setomaa Museums invites visitors to suggest traditional Seto names for its newest residents.

estonia.title: Study: Underground loan business survives through fear of public shaming
estonia.description: Researchers at the University of Tartu have mapped Estonia's social‑media‑based loan market, which operates outside state regulation. The study shows that this uncontrolled market survives thanks to illegal contracts and harsh debt‑collection methods.

estonia.title: Ülle Madise presidential candidacy hinging on Center, Isamaa
estonia.description: Estonia's political parties remain unable to agree on how and whether Chancellor of Justice Ülle Madise might run for president in September.

estonia.title: AJALOOLINE VIDEO ⟩ Ukraina mehitamata robotid tõid vaenlase tule alt välja kolm haavatud sõdurit
estonia.description: Ukraina 61. brigaadi insenerid näitasid sõjapidamise tulevikku, kui viisid läbi eduka ja elupäästva operatsiooni, kus mehitamata maismaasõidukid evakueerisid lahinguvälja kõige ohtlikumast tsoonist kolm haavatud sõdurit.

estonia.title: Krimilugusid saab kirjutada ka tapanäljas sarimõrvariteta
estonia.description: Puändirohkusele vaatamata rahulikult kulgevad õõvalood on kokku saanud kirjaniku ja näitleja Katariina Libe värskes lühijutukogumikus, mis on autoril esimene omalaadne.

estonia.title: Suur Toidutänav jõuab esmakordselt Viljandisse: mastaapsele sündmusele jäi algne asukoht kitsaks
estonia.description: Sel laupäeval, 1. augustil jõuab Eesti suurim rändav tänavatoidufestival esimest korda Viljandisse. Kuna sündmus kasvas oodatust suuremaks, koliti enam kui 40 toiduauto ja Sky Tivoli lõbustuspargiga festival esialgu plaanitud Lossi tänavalt hoopis avaramale Savi tänavale.

estonia.title: TÄNA ⟩ Kas Levadia vormistab Rootsis alustatud vägitüki?
estonia.description: Tallinna FCI Levadia võõrustab A. Le Coq Arenal Konverentsiliiga teise eelringi korduskohtumises IFK Göteborgi. Pall pannakse mängu kell 19.30.

estonia.title: POLITSEI TAUNIB ⟩ Somes levib ohtlik rööprähklus – roolis filmimine
estonia.description: Viimastel aastatel levib sotsiaalmeedias trend, kus muu hulgas avaliku elu tegelased tegelevad autoroolis mitme asjaga korraga. Autosõit ei tähenda enam ainult ühest kohast teise kulgemist, vaid rööprähklemist: samal ajal salvestatakse videoklippe, tehakse otseülekandeid ja jagatakse jälgijatega oma mõtteid. Selline käitumine on pannud paljusid küsima, kas roolis sotsiaalmeedia sisu loomine on kooskõlas liiklusohutuse põhimõtetega või on see normaliseerunud riskikäitumine.

estonia.title: Pikalt Itaalias pallinud Kaspar Treier jätkab karjääri Madridi klubis
estonia.description: Kaspar Treier jätkab karjääri Hispaanias. Eesti korvpallikoondise ääremängija sõlmis lepingu Hispaania kõrgliigasse naasnud Madridi Movistar Estudiantesiga, kus mängib hooajal 2026/27.

estonia.title: Raamatublogija soovitab: täpselt see raamat, kuhu pärast pikka tööpäeva sukelduda
estonia.description: Ashley Postoni «Seitse aastat meie vahel» on ajarännuga armastuslugu iseendaks kasvamisest, leinaga leppimisest ja täiuslikust toidust. Maagiaga vürtsitatud romantika - jah, palun! Oma lugemiselamust jagab raamatublogija Mariann Vendelin.

estonia.title: GRAAFIK ⟩ Korduvad seaduserikkumised võivad jätta taotleja Eesti kodakondsuseta
estonia.description: Valitsus keeldus neljapäevasel istungil ühele inimesele Eesti kodakondsuse andmisest, leides, et tema varasemad õigusrikkumised ei võimalda pidada teda õiguskuulekaks. Otsus näitab, et ka juhul, kui suurem osa karistustest on kustunud, võivad korduvad seaduserikkumised saada takistuseks Eesti kodakondsuse saamisel.

estonia.title: Venemaa tembeldas Telegrami asutaja Durovi terroristiks
estonia.description: Venemaa lisas täna Telegrami asutaja Pavel Durovi terroristide ja äärmuslaste nimekirja; vaid mõne päeva eest olid võimud teatanud, et taotlevad tema vahistamist süüdistuste alusel, mille kohaselt lasi Durov Ukraina luurel oma platvormi kasutada.

estonia.title: SAATUSLIK LAGRITS ⟩ Üks komm muutis pere laevareisi õudusunenäoks: Tallink tunnistas oma viga
estonia.description: Tallinki reisilaeva Megastar bufees valesti märgistatud lagrits põhjustas Soome pere 10-aastasel tütrel allergilise reaktsiooni. Hiljem tunnistas ettevõte, et allergeenide märgistamisel oli tehtud viga.

estonia.title: Lõks autojuhtidele: autopesula reegel, mis meenub paljudele alles remondiarvet kätte saades
estonia.description: Kujutage ette olukorda: sõidate automaatpesulasse, et auto puhtaks pesta, kuid väljute sealt kahjustatud sõiduki ja remondiarvega. Esmapilgul näib kõik selge – süüdi on teenusepakkuja, kes peab tekitatud kahju hüvitama. Tegelikult ei pruugi asi sugugi nii lihtne olla.

estonia.title: Aivar Pohlak: FIFA suudaks miljardeid kaasata ka erainvestoriteta
estonia.description: Kuku raadios rääkis FIFA plaanist kaasata uude ettevõttesse erainvestorid Eesti Jalgpalli Liidu president Aivar Pohlak, kelle hinnangul on Euroopal piisavalt mõju, et see peatada.

estonia.title: ALLAR JÕKS ⟩ Kunagi anti mõista, et leiaksin toetuse olles «mugavam». Ülle Madise on käitunud ainuvõimalikult
estonia.description: Miks Ülle Madise ei ütle kandideerimise osas «ei» või «jah»? See viimase kuu aja jooksul üks enim esitatud küsimus riigipea valimistega seoses iseloomustab, mis on pildil valesti. Vandeadvokaat Allar Jõks pani kirja oma kammitsemata mõtted teemal, kuidas peaks presidenti valima põhiseaduse mõtte järgi.

estonia.title: ÜLEVAADE ⟩ Raske rokk või hingestatud bluus? Nädalavahetuse suur muusikajuht Tallinnast Haapsaluni
estonia.description: Tulev nädalavahetus tõotab rokisõpradele olla tõeline maiuspala. Mitte ainult ei mürista pealinnas Tallinn Rock Festival, vaid Haapsalus saab kaasa elada ka maailma bluusiparemikule. Nii et ole sa klassikalise rokkmuusika fänn või hoopis raju bluusivana – suvist ja muusikalist meelelahutust jätkub kõigile!

estonia.title: GALERII JA VIDEO ⟩ Neljapäeval taasavati pidulikult lennujaama trammiliin, tramm hakkab sõitma laupäeval
estonia.description: Ülemiste linnakus tähistati trammiühenduse taastumist Tallinna lennujaama ja Ülemiste Cityga. Linnaelanikud saavad trammiga Ülemistesse ja lennujaama sõita alates laupäevast, 1. augustist.

estonia.title: Kristen Michal: Eestis läheb Rail Balticu ehitus hästi, isegi hanked ei kallinenud
estonia.description: Peaminister Kristen Michali sõnul on Eestis Rail Balticu trass hangetega kaetud ja ehitus läheb hästi. Kerkinud kütusehind hankeid kallimaks ei teinud.

latvia.title: A NATO aktiválta légi és szárazföldi védelmi rendszereit a lengyelországi légtérsértés után
latvia.description: Feltételezhetően orosz rakéta csapódott be az ukrán határ közelében.

latvia.description: Bocsánatot kért.

latvia.description: Kiadta a legfrissebb jelentését az ukrán légierő, ebben pontosan részletezik a július 30-i orosz támadást – számolt be az Ukrajinszka Pravda. A nagyszabású orosz támadás során rengeteg, különböző típusú rakétát vetettek be, ezek Ukrajna jelentős részén komoly károkat okoztak. Ott hajnalban riasztást kellett kiadni, ennek következtében az F-16-os vadászgépek is a levegőbe emelkedtek – közölte a TVP World. Később az orosz hatóságok megnevezték a ma hajnali támadás célpontjait, állításuk szerint nagyon súlyos csapásokat szenvedett el Ukrajna – közölte a Ria Novosztyi. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

latvia.title: Szibiha: Oroszország rettegett rakétája tört be a NATO területére
latvia.description: A július 30-i nagyszabású orosz támadás során rengeteg, különböző típusú rakétát vetettek be, ezek Ukrajna jelentős részén komoly károkat okoztak. Az egyik eszköz a szomszédos Lengyelországot is elérte – számolt be az RBK Ukraine.

latvia.title: Olyan vonatok érkeznek két fővonalra, amelyek még nem voltak Magyarországon
latvia.description: Elkészült a GYSEV első két új InterCity-motorvonata, amelyek a tervek szerint 2028-ig teljesen felváltják a Budapest–Győr–Szombathely és a Budapest–Győr–Sopron vonalakon közlekedő régebbi szerelvényeket. A járműbeszerzés részleteiről és a hazai vasúti flotta modernizációjának következő lépéseiről Vitézy Dávid közlekedési és beruházási miniszter számolt be Facebook-bejegyzésében .

latvia.title: Sprawa pocisku na Lubelszczyźnie analizowana "wspólnie z NATO". MSZ zapowiada dalsze kroki
latvia.description: Dalsze kroki dyplomatyczne zostaną podjęte po ustaleniu szczegółów - przekazał rzecznik MSZ Maciej Wewiór. Komentował sprawę pocisku, który spadł na Lubelszczyźnie. Poinformował, że sprawa analizowana jest "wspólnie z sojusznikami z NATO".

latvia.title: Pocisk nad Polską. Jest reakcja NATO
latvia.description: NATO pozostaje w ścisłym kontakcie z polskimi władzami w sprawie naruszenia polskiej przestrzeni powietrznej - poinformował rzecznik Naczelnego Dowództwa Sojuszniczych Sił w Europie pułkownik Martin O'Donnell. Wydarzenia na Lubelszczyźnie komentują też przedstawiciele światowej polityki, między innymi prezydent Francji Emmanuel Macron, szefowa Komisji Europejskiej Ursula von der Leyen czy szef ukraińskiego MSZ Andrij Sybiha.

latvia.title: Najskôr sirény, potom 10-metrový kráter. NATO potvrdilo, že Poľsko zasiahla ruská raketa
latvia.description: Raketa dopadla asi 90 kilometrov od ukrajinských hraníc.

latvia.title: NATO aktivovalo obranu. Poľský incident rieši velenie aliancie
latvia.description: Severoatlantická aliancia a Poľsko v reakcii na prenik zrejme ruskej rakety do poľského vzdušného priestoru aktivovali svoju vzdušnú a pozemnú obranu, povedal dnes agentúre Reuters hovorca vojenského veliteľstva NATO. Vrchný veliteľ spojeneckých síl NATO v Európe Alexus Grynkewich o incidente takisto hovoril s poľským náčelníkom generálneho štábu generálom Wiesławom Kukulom.

latvia.title: Protidrogová agenda se nemění, ujišťoval senátory Vojtěch. Proč se vůbec přesouvala, neřekl
latvia.description: Podle ministra zdravotnictví Adama Vojtěcha (za ANO) se protidrogové agendy nijak nedotkl její přesun z gesce úřadu vlády pod ministerstvo zdravotnictví. Na ministerstvo se přesunuli všichni experti, kteří o to stáli, uvedl ve čtvrtek šéf resortu na veřejném slyšení v Senátu k odpovědnosti státu za politiku závislostí. Senátoři doufali, že se dozvědí, proč bylo nutné agendu přesunout. Mnozí ze setkání odcházeli zklamaní.

latvia.title: NATO confirmă că obiectul prăbușit în estul Poloniei este „o rachetă rusească de tip necunoscut”
latvia.description: Autoritățile poloneze investighează un loc al prăbușirii unui rachete rusești, în estul țării, în contextul în care avioane de vânătoare au fost mobilizate în noaptea de miercuri spre joi, ca răspuns la intensificarea activității militare a Rusiei în apropierea graniței cu Ucraina, informează TVP World.

latvia.title: Ucrainenii au pierdut un avion de vânătoare F-16 în timpul unei misiuni de luptă. „Pilotul a fost nevoit să se catapulteze”
latvia.description: Forțele Aeriene ale Ucrainei au anunțat miercuri că au pierdut contactul cu un avion de vânătoare F-16 în timpul unei misiuni de luptă, după ce aeronava a suferit o „situație de urgență” în zbor. Pilotul a reușit să se ejecteze și „se află în deplină siguranță”.

latvia.title: Prima convorbire dintre Drapatîi și comandantul NATO: Ce a cerut Ucraina pentru a schimba soarta războiului cu Rusia
latvia.description: Comandantul-șef al Armatei ucrainene, Mihailo Drapatîi, i-a prezentat generalului Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul suprem al Forțelor Aliate NATO în Europa, prioritățile Kievului pe câmpul de luptă. În prima discuție dintre cei doi, Drapatîi a vorbit despre consolidarea liniilor defensive, intensificarea loviturilor de precizie asupra forțelor ruse și nevoia Ucrainei de rachete Patriot.

latvia.title: Anchetă de trădare în Franța: un fost pilot francez de avioane de vânătoare Rafale, cercetat pentru spionaj în favoarea Chinei
latvia.description: Un fost pilot de Rafale din cadrul Marinei franceze a fost pus sub anchetă oficială la Paris pentru presupuse activități de spionaj în favoarea Chinei.

latvia.title: Incendiu la un centru logistic al Wildberries din orașul rus Riazan, după un atac cu drone
latvia.description: Instalaţii industriale din oraşul rus Riazan au luat foc în urma unui atac cu drone, afirmă guvernatorul regiunii, transmite Reuters.

latvia.title: „Înseamnă sărăcie curată”. Cum afectează seceta extremă și invazia de ciori recoltele României: pierderi uriașe și disperare la sate
latvia.description: Seceta extremă pune în pericol recoltele în mai multe zone din țară, unde nu a plouat atât de mult. În județul Dolj, de pildă, irigațiile au fost oprite de peste două săptămâni, din cauza nivelului extrem de scăzut al Dunării. „Asta înseamnă sărăcie curată”, se plâng oamenii. În județul Iași, în schimb, fermierii se confruntă cu altă problemă: invazia de ciori, care ar putea reduce recolta de floarea-soarelui cu până la 40%.

latvia.title: Trump i-a adus un omagiu lui Lindsey Graham, la Catedrala din Washington, în prezenţa lui Zelenski şi Netanyahu
latvia.description: Preşedintele american Donald Trump i-a adus marţi un omagiu senatorului republican Lindsey Graham, un aliat apropiat, pe care preşedintele l-a catalogat drept un prieten „de neuitat” şi un „mare politician”, pronunţând elogiul funebru la Catedrala din Washington, relatează AFP, citată de News.ro.

latvia.title: Senatorii americani au convenit asupra unui proiect de lege privind noi sancţiuni împotriva Rusiei. Când va fi adoptat
latvia.description: Senatorii americani au convenit marţi asupra unui proiect de lege menit să exercite o presiune sporită asupra Rusiei prin noi sancţiuni, iar amendamentele publicate recent prevăd ca actul normativ să poarte numele senatorului republican Lindsey Graham, care a susţinut iniţiativa înainte de decesul său.

latvia.title: Arest prelungit pentru stagiara acuzată de spionaj la NATO: mister, suspiciuni și reacții internaționale
latvia.description: O femeie canadiană de origine chineză acuzată de spionaj în timp ce lucra ca stagiară la sediul militar al NATO din Belgia va rămâne în arest preventiv încă o lună, a declarat marți un purtător de cuvânt al Parchetului Federal belgian, citat de Reuters.

latvia.title: Mafia italiană încearcă să achiziţioneze drone asemănătoare celor folosite în războiul din Ucraina. „Nu suntem pregătiţi să ne apărăm”
latvia.description: Procurorul-şef din Palermo, Maurizio de Lucia, a declarat marţi că mafia caută să cumpere drone militare precum cele folosite în războiul din Ucraina, relatează agenţia de presă Ansa, potrivit Agerpres.

latvia.title: Diana Șoșoacă, implicată într-un accident rutier pe bulevardul Iuliu Maniu. Eurodeputata a fost transportată la spital cu răni ușoare
latvia.description: Diana Șoșoacă a fost implicată joi după-amiază într-un accident rutier produs pe bulevardul Iuliu Maniu din București, a anunțat Brigada Rutieră. Eurodeputata a fost transportată la Spitalul Universitar cu răni ușoare, au precizat surse din poliție pentru HotNews. Brigada Rutieră a fost sesizată prin apel la 112 în jurul orei 14:35 cu privire la producerea …

latvia.title: NATO confirmă că o rachetă rusească, „de un tip încă necunoscut”, s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul Poloniei
latvia.description: NATO a transmis joi că a activat, împreună cu Polonia, sistemele de apărare aeriană și terestră după ce, potrivit Alianței, o rachetă rusească, al cărei tip nu a fost încă stabilit, a pătruns în spațiul aerian polonez și s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul țării, a declarat un purtător de cuvânt al comandamentului militar al NATO, potrivit …

latvia.title: Cea mai mare afacere din domeniul imobiliar făcută vreodată
latvia.description: Peter Minuit, guvernatorul colonial al orașului New Amsterdam, coboară de pe o navă olandeză, îi cheamă pe șefii indieni și începe negocierile. Le oferă mărgele, ace, pânză, cuțite și nasturi pentru a cumpăra întreaga insulă Manhattan. Adunate, toate obiectele valorau 24 de dolari, în banii de azi, scrie și The Atlantic. Va trebui să se …

latvia.title: Legea integrității, măcelărită în Parlament: PSD și AUR au votat ca demnitarii să fie scutiți de la declararea banilor cash / Amendamentul ”Fritz” vizează o singură persoană – președintele USR
latvia.description: Demnitarii vor fi scutiți de la declararea banilor cash pe care îi dețin, potrivit unui amendament la legea integrității depus joi în Comisia Juridică din Senat de senatoarea ”suveranistă” Cosmina Cerva și votat de PSD și AUR. Un alt amendament, depus de PSD și votat de AUR și de doi senatori PNL, e îndreptat împotriva […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Police find €3,000 in cash in pockets of suspected money mule
latvia.description: Officers from the Northern Prefecture detained a 37‑year‑old Latvian resident in Tallinn on Monday, discovering €3,000 in cash in his pockets. Police believe he acted as a money mule in a series of fraud cases.

latvia.title: 63 migrants from Belarus caught in Estonia last week and more expected, PPA says
latvia.description: Over the past week, 63 migrants with no legal right to be in Estonia have been caught by the police – almost double the number apprehended last year. The authorities say the situation is connected to the migration pressure on the Latvian-Belarus border and will likely continue until the weather worsens.

latvia.title: Minister: Estonia sends extra border guards to Latvia as Belarus drives migrant surge
latvia.description: Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border. The decision came after several dozen illegal migrants who entered the country through Belarus and Latvia were detained in Estonia in recent days.

latvia.title: AJALOOLINE VIDEO ⟩ Ukraina mehitamata robotid tõid vaenlase tule alt välja kolm haavatud sõdurit
latvia.description: Ukraina 61. brigaadi insenerid näitasid sõjapidamise tulevikku, kui viisid läbi eduka ja elupäästva operatsiooni, kus mehitamata maismaasõidukid evakueerisid lahinguvälja kõige ohtlikumast tsoonist kolm haavatud sõdurit.

latvia.title: Venemaa tembeldas Telegrami asutaja Durovi terroristiks
latvia.description: Venemaa lisas täna Telegrami asutaja Pavel Durovi terroristide ja äärmuslaste nimekirja; vaid mõne päeva eest olid võimud teatanud, et taotlevad tema vahistamist süüdistuste alusel, mille kohaselt lasi Durov Ukraina luurel oma platvormi kasutada.

latvia.title: Euroopa Komisjon maksis Ukrainale välja järgmised 3,47 miljardit eurot
latvia.description: Euroopa Komisjon maksis neljapäeval Ukrainale 90 miljardi euro suuruse Ukraina toetuslaenu kaitseharu raames välja 3,47 miljardit eurot Ukraina kiireloomulistele sõjaliste vajaduste katmiseks.

latvia.title: Livonian festival taking place this weekend
latvia.description: At the end of July, you can go to Latvia's western Kurzeme region not only to sunbathe, but also to get to know and celebrate the region's Livonian heritage.

latvia.title: Economics Minister proposes banning overcrowded living among foreigners
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers Union), has approached the Saeima’s Committee on Defence, Home Affairs and Corruption Prevention with a call to launch a discussion on a new mechanism for immigration controls, the Economics Ministry said in a release on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvian climber who survived fall on Denali returns to Rīga
latvia.description: On the evening of Tuesday, 28 July, Mārtiņš Bilzēns, a member of the Latvian mountaineering group who had been seriously injured, returned to Latvia from Alaska.

latvia.title: Rīga's parks to host musical performances throughout August
latvia.description: This year, Riga will be celebrating its 825th anniversary, and everyone is invited to attend the wide-ranging festive events. Throughout August, the capital’s evenings will be filled with music from the park concert series at the Dzegužkalns Open-Air Stage, Ziemeļblāzma Palace Park and Vērmane Garden.

latvia.title: Off-duty police officer drives drunk, crashes, flees scene
latvia.description: On Wednesday evening, the State Police in Aizkraukle arrested an off-duty police officer – a senior inspector – who, whilst under the influence of alcohol with a blood alcohol level of 3.18 per mille, caused a road traffic accident and subsequently fled the scene, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Latvia's power distribution network to expand further
latvia.description: The state-owned company AS ‘Sadales tīkls’ (ST) will build two new substations in Saulkrasti and Saldus, as well as modernise the existing infrastructure in Salacgrīva, thereby enabling new electricity producers and consumers to be connected to the grid, the company announced on July 30.

latvia.title: Does the Saeima provide good value for money?
latvia.description: In the pre-election period it is perhaps not surprising that many politicians are trying to polish their credentials as money-managers, calling for controlled spending, probes in NGO funding, a review of scientific research costs and various other fiscal discipline measures.

latvia.title: Latvia's Interior Minister calls for investigation of police chief
latvia.description: Minister for the Interior Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) is set to call for an internal investigation into State Police (VP) Chief Armands Ruks in connection with "various systematic breaches" in the State Police’s operations, including an incident in Priekule where a drunk police officer killed a man, notably whilst off duty.

latvia.title: 'Horos' contemporary dance festival comes to Rīga
latvia.description: On July 30th and 31st, Rīga will host the contemporary dance festival "Horos", which has moved from Aizpute to the capital for the first time.

latvia.title: Liepāja street upgrades set to continue
latvia.description: The road surfacing programme will continue in Liepāja until 2030, reports Latvian Radio, though not everyone is happy with the results so far.

latvia.title: Causes of Pitbull show cancellation to be investigated
latvia.description: There will be no new Pitbull concert in the near future, Ģirts Majors, head of the concert organiser “Positivus Music”, said on the Latvian Television programme “Morning Panorama” on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvia will get hotter on Thursday
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become hotter on Thursday.

latvia.title: Balticovo builds flats for employees in Iecava, Latvia
latvia.description: The poultry farming company AS ‘Balticovo’ has invested more than two million euros in a staff apartment block project in Iecava, the company announced on July 29.

latvia.title: Roadworks in central Rīga set to begin
latvia.description: Construction of the cycle path along 11 November Embankment will begin with the section from Akmens Bridge to Dzelzceļa Bridge, where the first construction works are due to start in August. Meanwhile, on Ģertrūdes Street, the section from Aleksandra Čaka Street to Krišjāņa Barona Street will be renovated, Rīga City Council said.

latvia.title: Security guard appears in Latvian court on suspicion of spying for Russia
latvia.description: On July 29th a former store security guard was led into a Rīga court in handcuffs, accused not only of espionage, but also of hooliganism and robbery.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 29th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Police: Unauthorised gathering is illegal, Pitbull-themed or not
latvia.description: Following the cancellation of singer Pitbull’s concert, which was due to take place on 29 July at the Mežaparks Grand Open-Air Stage, calls have been made on social media and other online platforms for people to gather at the planned concert venue nonetheless. The State Police point out that such calls are unlawful.

latvia.title: Estonia sending more border guards to help Latvia
latvia.description: Estonian public media ERR News reports that Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border.

latvia.title: Dementia a bigger problem in Latvia than figures suggest
latvia.description: In Latvia, just over 5,000 people have been officially diagnosed with dementia, but using internationally recognized methodology, it is estimated that the real number with the condition could reach as many as 38,000 [Data from the non-governmental organization “Alzheimer Europe”] according to a release from the Society Integration Fund (SIF).

latvia.title: Latvia's retail sector enjoyed a strong June
latvia.description: Calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) compiled by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) and published on July 29th show that, compared to June 2025, in June 2026 Latvia's total retail trade turnover rose by 4.8 %.

latvia.title: Rīga's hotels also affected by cancelled Pitbull show
latvia.description: Just one day before the event, the concert by American musician Pitbull in Mežaparks has been cancelled. The hospitality sector is also already facing cancellations of bookings, whilst the Consumer Rights Protection Centre will be monitoring the situation to ensure that consumer rights are upheld, namely that the money spent on tickets is refunded, Latvan Radio reported on July 29.

latvia.title: Forum Cinemas to take over Cinamon in Rīga
latvia.description: The Competition Council (KP) has authorised the subsidiary of “Forum Cinemas Latvia OU” (Forum Cinemas) to acquire the lease rights to premises adapted for cinema use in the ‘Akropole Alfa’ shopping centre, where SIA ‘Cinamon Operations Latvia’ (‘Cinamon’) currently operates, the KP announced Wednesday.

latvia.title: Latvia-Ukraine driving licence parity coming in September
latvia.description: From September 2nd, 2026, an agreement between Latvia and Ukraine on the mutual recognition and exchange of driving licences will enter into force, which will allow nationals of both countries to exchange driving licences issued in their own country for a driving licence of the other country without the need to take a test.

latvia.title: Over 100 drug hiding spots found in criminal case in Latvia
latvia.description: Following the admission of a young woman to Kuldīga Hospital last September after suffering drug poisoning, the State Police arrested a man and launched an investigation, during which they discovered more than 100 drug dens in the forests around Jelgava and Jūrmala. The criminal case has been referred to the Prosecutor’s Office, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Booze sales restrictions have not changed consumption much in Latvia
latvia.description: The restrictions on the sale of alcoholic beverages, introduced a year ago, have not significantly reduced alcohol purchases, but have changed shoppers’ buying habits, with people adjusting the times at which they shop, according to retailers surveyed by the LETA news agency on July 29.

latvia.title: New industrial park planned for Rēzekne
latvia.description: A new industrial park is being planned north of Rēzekne in eastern Latvia which should be one of the most significant city development projects in the coming years.

latvia.title: Any Russian 'little green men' will be neutralised, says Latvian Defence Minister
latvia.description: Currently, a direct military, conventional Russian attack on NATO is not possible, and stating this is not just an attempt to calm public fears of conflict, Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Latvian police forces could introduce daily alcohol testing
latvia.description: Following the tragedy in Priekule, the State Police might introduce alcohol tests at the start of the working day as a preventative measure, particularly for officers who carry a weapon or drive a service vehicle, Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 29.

latvia.title: Ukrainian aid organisation continues work after warehouse fire
latvia.description: The “Tavi draugi” association is continuing its work, despite a potentially malicious fire last week in which a large proportion of the aid intended for Ukrainians was destroyed. Several businesspeople have offered the association premises, and the local council is also considering options. However, for the time being, volunteers are carrying on with their work in temporary tents, Latvian Television reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Latvia's eastern border to be reinforced until end of 2027
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Government took note of a report from the Ministry of the Interior on the construction of infrastructure along the country’s eastern border. Work is scheduled to be completed by the end of this year, although the State Real Estate (VNĪ) plans to continue work on certain sections until the end of next year, Latvian Radio reported July 28.

latvia.title: Pitbull Rīga show cancelled last minute due to 'technical issues'
latvia.description: Due to technical issues that arose during the set-up for the concert, the scheduled Pitbull concert at the Mežaparks Grand Open-Air Stage in Rīga on 29 July has been cancelled, according to organisers.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 28th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia is an EU hepatitis blackspot
latvia.description: Data on viral hepatitis published by Eurostat to mark World Hepatitis Day, observed each year on 28 July, comes with mixed news for Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian government approves hospital reform
latvia.description: On Tuesday 28 July, following lengthy discussions, the Government endorsed the hospital network reform drawn up by the Ministry of Health (VM), which provides for the introduction of three tiers of hospitals – local, regional and multi-speciality – from next year, replacing the current five-tier system.

latvia.title: Foreign students could be subjected to stricter admission rules in future
latvia.description: In preparation for the new academic year, some higher education institutions are promising to tighten their entry requirements for international students from third countries, Latvian Radio reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Expect jams on Rīga-Liepāja highway this weekend
latvia.description: This coming weekend, on 31 July and 1 August, the “Summer Sound 2026” festival will take place on Liepāja beach, so congestions are expected on the highway, according to the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD).

latvia.title: Rain damaged 53 road sections in Talsi vicinity last week
latvia.description: Last week’s heavy rain in Talsi Municipality has caused damage to 53 sections of road, Ansis Bērziņš, Chair of Talsi Municipal Council, told the LETA news agency on July 28.

latvia.title: Woman steals thousands from neighbour's bank account
latvia.description: In Kuldīga municipality, a woman unlawfully took more than 3,000 euros from a bank account from someone who had trusted her, according to the State Police.

latvia.title: Farmers in western Latvia struggle to harvest grain
latvia.description: For the most part, Latvia has good potential for a grain harvest this year, although in many places the rain is currently delaying the harvest. The situation is better in Zemgale, Latgale and Vidzeme, but farmers in Kurzeme are currently facing the greatest difficulties, where the rainfall has also washed out roads in many places, Latvian Radio reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Mere no more: discount chain falls foul of sanctions
latvia.description: Until recently here were 12 "Mere" stores in Latvia, in Rīga, Liepāja, Tukums, Jēkabpils and other cities, but now they have been closed because one of Mere's owners - Russian businessman Sergey Schneider - is included in the European Union (EU) sanctions list.

latvia.title: Latvia's largest landfill will be full within 10 years
latvia.description: In Latvia, over the last ten years, the amount of household waste per capita per year has increased by around 100 kilograms. The capacity of the Getliņi landfill site will, at best, be exhausted within the next ten years, Imants Stirāns, Chairman of the Board of SIA “Getliņi eko”, told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Twenty Rīga schools still have spots for high schoolers
latvia.description: A total of 4,869 applicants – or 91 per cent of those wishing to enrol – have been accepted to study in Year 10 at Rīga municipal schools, whilst there are still places available at around 20 schools, the Riga City Council’s External Communications Department told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Oil contamination found in river in Jelgava
latvia.description: Following a complaint from the public regarding possible contamination by petroleum products in the Driksa, a tributary of the Lielupe River, the State Environmental Service (VVD) carried out an inspection and found a film characteristic of petroleum products, VVD said on July 28.

latvia.title: Latvia's farms are mostly plugged into the internet
latvia.description: In 2023, about 43% of EU farms reported having internet access. Some northern and central European countries such as Denmark, Germany, Slovakia, Latvia, Czechia, and Austria, had rates above 90%, according to Eurostat data published on July 24th.

latvia.title: Donations sought to support work of Latvia's destroyed consulate in Ukraine
latvia.description: As previously reported, the building of the Latvian Honorary Consulate in Sloviansk was severely damaged in a Russian airstrike on July 24th. Now The "Entrepreneurs for Peace" Foundation, in cooperation with journalist Ieva Vārna, is launching a fundraising campaign to help Honorary Consul Oleksandr Pavenko equip new premises for the Latvian representation in the Donetsk region.

latvia.title: Charity donation drive will help kids get equipped for return to school
latvia.description: For many Latvian families, the start of the new school year in September brings not only the excitement of returning to school, but also significant financial and emotional pressure.

latvia.title: Gaisa Bridge in Rīga to be reconstructed
latvia.description: Rīga City Council has signed a contract with SIA ‘Projekts 3’ for the reconstruction of the Gaisa Bridge. The design work is scheduled to be completed in 2027, whilst the reconstruction of the Gaisa Bridge is due to be finished by 2030, the local authority has announced.

latvia.title: Coach arrested for alleged sexual abuse of child in Latvia
latvia.description: The police have launched criminal proceedings against a coach at the “Ogres novada Lāči” children’s and youth ice hockey club in connection with alleged sexual abuse of a child during a camp, Latvian Television reported on July 27.

latvia.title: German DHL to buy Venipak in Baltics
latvia.description: The German postal and logistics group DHL is to acquire Venipak, a parcel delivery company operating in the Baltic states and Poland, the DHL Group and Venipak announced on Monday, July 27.

latvia.title: Police officer claims to not remember killing man in Priekule, Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police officer arrested in connection with the murder of a man in Priekule has claimed that he cannot remember the incident, as stated on Monday evening by Armands Ruks, Chief of the State Police, on the Latvian Television programme “Panorāma”.

latvia.title: Horoskopi 31. jūlijam. Atvērtība sadarbībai šodien var dot labāku rezultātu nekā centieni visu paveikt vienatnē

lithuania.title: 69 mlrd. eurų skylė Rusijos biudžete: rado naują taikinį
lithuania.description: Rusijos federalinė mokesčių tarnyba pradėjo masiškai siuntinėti laiškus darbingo amžiaus bedarbiams rusams, kurie atlieka stambius pirkimus neturėdami oficialių pajamų, praneša kanalas RBK, remdamasis teisininkais ir vienos mokesčių inspekcijos medžiaga.

lithuania.title: Sureagavo NATO: pasiruošusi imtis visų būtinų priemonių dėl Lenkijos
lithuania.description: Išplatintame pareiškime NATO Europos sąjungininkų pajėgų štabas pabrėžė, kad glaudžiai bendradarbiauja su Lenkija dėl jos oro erdvės pažeidimo ir nurodė, jog „imtųsi visų būtinų priemonių“ teritorijai apginti.

lithuania.title: Bandydami kirsti Lamanšą žuvo keturi žmonės, praneša Prancūzijos pareigūnai
lithuania.description: Keturi žmonės žuvo per du atskirus bandymus mažais laiveliais kirsti Lamanšo sąsiaurį, ketvirtadienį pranešė Prancūzijos pareigūnai.

lithuania.title: „Nesvarbu, viduje dronas ar vibratorius“: Ukrainos bepiločių pajėgų vadas kreipėsi į rusus
lithuania.description: Ukrainos bepiločių sistemų pajėgų vadas Robertas Brovdi patvirtino, kad praėjusią naktį ukrainiečių dronai sunaikino dar kelis prekybos milžinės „Wildberries“ sandėlius Rusijos teritorijoje, ir užsiminė, kad atakos tęsis.

lithuania.title: LAT padėjo tašką kontrabandos byloje: organizatoriui liko galioti beveik 90 tūkst. eurų sankcijos
lithuania.description: Lietuvos Aukščiausiasis Teismas, išnagrinėjęs nuteistojo ir jo gynėjo kasacinius skundus, konstatavęs, kad nuteistasis už cigarečių kontrabandos, šių cigarečių gabenimo Lietuvos teritorijoje organizavimą ir papirkimą nuteistas pagrįstai, paliko jam galioti apkaltinamąjį nuosprendį ir skirtą galutinę bausmę – 55 500 Eur baudą bei 32 550 Eur vertės turto konfiskavimą.
